',source:'https://satyajitray.org/making-of-pather-panchali/',eTitle:'The first shoot—and a delay.',eText:'The Ray archive places the start of filming the train-discovery sequence in a kaash field in October 1952. It recounts that the crew returned to find the flowers eaten by cattle and had to wait for the season to return.',hot:[['01 · THE FIELD','The seasonal field was central to the scene. Natural conditions could not be controlled like a studio setting.'],['02 · THE TRAIN','The train-discovery sequence was an early filming undertaking for Pather Panchali. These are new illustrative visuals, not frames from the movie.'],['03 · THE WAIT','The crew’s reported return to damaged grass demonstrates the unpredictable nature of location filmmaking.']],wide:'The world surrounds the figures. Geography and waiting create space for an important discovery.',detail:'A closer view can prioritize faces and anticipation, but at the cost of understanding the wider landscape.'}
];
const worldState={index:0,point:-1,angle:null,sound:false,ctx:null,raf:0,transitionTimer:null};
const worldStage=document.getElementById('worldStage');
const worldImg=document.getElementById('worldPhoto');
const worldNextImg=document.getElementById('worldNextPhoto');
function worldRender(){const w=worlds[worldState.index];
 worldStage.dataset.world=worldState.index;
 document.getElementById('worldYear').textContent=w.year;document.getElementById('worldEra').textContent=w.era;document.getElementById('worldTitle').textContent=w.title;document.getElementById('worldDeck').textContent=w.deck;
 document.getElementById('worldNumber').textContent='WORLD '+String(worldState.index+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / 04';
 document.getElementById('worldEvidenceTitle').textContent=w.eTitle;document.getElementById('worldEvidenceText').textContent=w.eText;
 document.getElementById('worldEvidenceLink').href=w.source;
 document.getElementById('worldPrev').disabled=worldState.index===0;document.getElementById('worldNext').disabled=worldState.index===3;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-world-choice]').forEach(b=>{let active=Number(b.dataset.worldChoice)===worldState.index;b.classList.toggle('active',active);b.setAttribute('aria-current',active?'step':'false')});
 document.querySelectorAll('.world-hotspot').forEach((b,i)=>{b.classList.toggle('selected',i===worldState.point);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===worldState.point));b.setAttribute('aria-label',w.hot[i][0]+': explore');document.getElementById('worldHotLabel'+i).textContent=w.hot[i][0]});
 const annotation=document.getElementById('worldOverlayNote');annotation.hidden=worldState.point<0;
 if(worldState.point>=0){document.getElementById('worldOverlayTitle').textContent=w.hot[worldState.point][0];document.getElementById('worldOverlayDescription').textContent=w.hot[worldState.point][1]}
 document.getElementById('worldDetailTitle').textContent=worldState.point>=0?w.hot[worldState.point][0]:'Look closely.';
 document.getElementById('worldDetailText').textContent=worldState.point>=0?w.hot[worldState.point][1]:'Select one of the three glowing details in the scene to uncover the documented story.';
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-world-choice-angle]').forEach(b=>{const active=b.dataset.worldChoiceAngle===worldState.angle;b.classList.toggle('selected',active);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active))});
 document.getElementById('worldFeedback').textContent=worldState.angle===null?'Which image would you reveal first? Both are valid choices, but they ask the audience to pay attention to different things.':w[worldState.angle];
 document.getElementById('worldField').style.display=worldState.index===3?'':'none';
 worldStage.style.setProperty('--world-zoom',worldState.angle==='detail'?'1.23':'1.045');
}
function worldChoose(index){const n=Math.max(0,Math.min(worlds.length-1,index));if(n===worldState.index)return;
 worldStopAudio();worldState.index=n;worldState.point=-1;worldState.angle=null;window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});
 clearTimeout(worldState.transitionTimer);
 if(state.motion&&!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches){worldNextImg.style.backgroundImage=`url('${worlds[n].image}')`;worldStage.classList.remove('changing');void worldStage.offsetWidth;worldStage.classList.add('changing');worldState.transitionTimer=setTimeout(()=>{worldImg.style.backgroundImage=`url('${worlds[worldState.index].image}')`;worldStage.classList.remove('changing')},1080)}else{worldImg.style.backgroundImage=`url('${worlds[n].image}')`;worldStage.classList.remove('changing')}
 worldRender()}
function worldAudioStop(){const c=worldState.ctx;worldState.ctx=null;worldState.sound=false;const b=document.getElementById('worldSound');b.textContent='♪ Play original atmosphere';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');if(c){try{c.close().catch(()=>{})}catch{}}}
function worldStopAudio(){worldAudioStop()}
function worldAudioStart(){worldAudioStop();try{const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)throw Error('unsupported');let c=new AC();worldState.ctx=c;
 let buf=c.createBuffer(1,c.sampleRate*2,c.sampleRate);let a=buf.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)a[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*.45;
 let source=c.createBufferSource();source.buffer=buf;source.loop=true;const filter=c.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=[350,520,700,290][worldState.index];const gain=c.createGain();gain.gain.value=.06;source.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(c.destination);source.start();
 worldState.sound=true;const b=document.getElementById('worldSound');b.textContent='Ⅱ Stop original atmosphere';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true')
 }catch(e){worldAudioStop();toast('Audio unavailable in this browser')}}
function worldSave(){const w=worlds[worldState.index];const discover=worldState.point>=0?w.hot[worldState.point][1]:w.eText;const t=`Time Worlds / ${w.year} / ${w.eTitle}\n${discover}\nMy experiment: ${worldState.angle?w[worldState.angle]:'Not yet selected'}\nResearch: ${w.source}`;state.notes=(state.notes?state.notes+'\n\n':'')+t;document.getElementById('noteText').value=state.notes;save();toast('Discovery added to your private notes')}
function worldCapture(){const path=worlds[worldState.index].image;const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{try{const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=1600;c.height=900;const x=c.getContext('2d');const sc=Math.max(1600/img.width,900/img.height);x.drawImage(img,(1600-img.width*sc)/2,(900-img.height*sc)/2,img.width*sc,img.height*sc);const fade=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,900);fade.addColorStop(0,'#0009');fade.addColorStop(.5,'#0000');fade.addColorStop(1,'#000d');x.fillStyle=fade;x.fillRect(0,0,1600,900);x.fillStyle='#eac99d';x.font='24px Georgia';x.fillText('ORIGIN  /  AN ORIGINAL VISUAL INTERPRETATION',58,75);x.fillStyle='#fff1d4';x.font='bold 88px Georgia';x.fillText(worlds[worldState.index].year,58,765);x.font='25px Georgia';x.fillText(worlds[worldState.index].title,58,819);let a=document.createElement('a');a.download='ORIGIN-world-'+worlds[worldState.index].year+'.png';a.href=c.toDataURL('image/png');a.click();toast('Original cinematic frame exported')}catch(e){toast('Frame export unavailable')}};img.onerror=()=>toast('Image not ready');img.src=path}
function worldTick(now){worldState.raf=0;if(state.view!=='worlds'||!state.motion||!state.entered)return;const c=document.getElementById('worldParticles');const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.5),W=Math.round(r.width*d),H=Math.round(r.height*d);if(!W||!H)return;if(c.width!==W||c.height!==H){c.width=W;c.height=H};let x=c.getContext('2d');x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
 const t=now/1000;const count=worldState.index===2?88:worldState.index===3?80:58;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const px=(i*117.73 + Math.sin(i+t*.13)*15 +W*8)%W;const py=(i*91.13 +t*(worldState.index===2?13:3)*(i%3+1))%H;
 x.strokeStyle=worldState.index===2?'rgba(193,224,231,.16)':worldState.index===1?'rgba(255,222,161,.13)':'rgba(245,214,167,.12)';x.fillStyle=x.strokeStyle;
 if(worldState.index===2){x.lineWidth=.8*d;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(px,py);x.lineTo(px-3*d,py+12*d);x.stroke()}else{x.beginPath();x.arc(px,py,(.6+i%3*.34)*d,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill()}}
 worldState.raf=requestAnimationFrame(worldTick)}
function worldAnimate(){if(worldState.raf)cancelAnimationFrame(worldState.raf);worldState.raf=0;if(state.entered&&state.view==='worlds'&&state.motion)worldState.raf=requestAnimationFrame(worldTick);else {const c=document.getElementById('worldParticles');c.getContext('2d').clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height)}}
function worldPointer(e){if(!state.motion||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches)return;const r=worldStage.getBoundingClientRect();worldStage.style.setProperty('--world-px',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*-15+'px');worldStage.style.setProperty('--world-py',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5)*-11+'px')}
worldStage.addEventListener('pointermove',worldPointer,{passive:true});worldStage.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{worldStage.style.setProperty('--world-px','0px');worldStage.style.setProperty('--world-py','0px')});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-world-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>worldChoose(Number(b.dataset.worldChoice)));
document.querySelectorAll('.world-hotspot').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{worldState.point=Number(b.dataset.point);worldRender()});document.getElementById('worldOverlayClose').onclick=()=>{worldState.point=-1;worldRender()};
document.querySelectorAll('[data-world-choice-angle]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{worldState.angle=b.dataset.worldChoiceAngle;worldRender()});
document.getElementById('worldPrev').onclick=()=>worldChoose(worldState.index-1);document.getElementById('worldNext').onclick=()=>worldChoose(worldState.index+1);
document.getElementById('tryWorldsBtn').onclick=()=>enter('worlds');document.getElementById('jumpWorlds').onclick=()=>{worldChoose(Math.min(3,Math.max(0,state.act===0?0:state.act-1)));switchView('worlds')};
document.getElementById('worldSave').onclick=worldSave;document.getElementById('worldCapture').onclick=worldCapture;document.getElementById('worldSound').onclick=()=>worldState.sound?worldAudioStop():worldAudioStart();document.getElementById('worldField').onclick=()=>switchView('scene');
worldStage.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target!==worldStage)return;if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowRight'){worldChoose(worldState.index+(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1));e.preventDefault()}});
let worldTouchX=null;worldStage.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('button'))worldTouchX=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});worldStage.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(worldTouchX===null)return;const diff=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-worldTouchX;worldTouchX=null;if(Math.abs(diff)>70)worldChoose(worldState.index+(diff<0?1:-1))},{passive:true});
const oldV6SwitchView=switchView;switchView=function(id){if(state.view==='worlds'&&id!=='worlds'){worldAudioStop();if(worldState.raf)cancelAnimationFrame(worldState.raf);worldState.raf=0}oldV6SwitchView(id);if(id==='worlds'){document.getElementById('headerSubtitle').textContent='THE WORLDS BETWEEN · 1943–1952';worldAnimate()}};
const oldV6Portal=portal;portal=function(){worldAudioStop();if(worldState.raf)cancelAnimationFrame(worldState.raf);worldState.raf=0;oldV6Portal();document.getElementById('headerSubtitle').textContent='THE CINEMATIC EDITION · 006'};
const oldV6ToggleMotion=toggleMotion;toggleMotion=function(){oldV6ToggleMotion();worldAnimate()};document.getElementById('motionBtn').onclick=toggleMotion;
window.addEventListener('pagehide',worldAudioStop);
worldRender();

</script>
</body>
</html>
